title: PAFEN and Lumitel sign USD 10m contract to extend 4G broadband in rural Burundi
description: PAFEN, Burundi's government digital-inclusion programme, and Lumitel (Viettel Burundi) sign a USD 10 million contract to extend 4G broadband connectivity in rural areas, co-financed 44 per cent by the Government of Burundi through PAFEN and 56 per cent by Lumitel. SETIC ties the project to improving access to digital public services, reducing the digital divide, and stimulating local entrepreneurship.
original_amount: US$5,620,000 (Lumitel's share of a US$10,000,000 contract)

scope_basis: Additional financing to a digital foundations project; no specific non-digital use is named.
title: Additional Financing to the Burundi Digital Foundations Project - Modernization of Public Financial Management
description: Additional financing to expand and deepen Burundi's digital foundations project, with emphasis on public financial management modernization.

scope_basis: Stated uses are broadband, digital government platforms, cybersecurity and digital skills.
title: Burundi Digital Foundations Project
description: Establishes digital foundations in Burundi including broadband connectivity, digital government platforms, cybersecurity, and digital skills.

scope_basis: The amount recorded is only the digital payment delivery sub-component.
title: Burundi Cash for Jobs Project — Digital Payment Delivery Component
description: Digital payment delivery sub-component (~$15M imputed of $150M total) of the Burundi Cash for Jobs Project. Supports mobile money and digital transfer mechanisms for cash-for-work payments, including beneficiary registration systems with digital ID verification.

scope_basis: Vendor credit funds the state telecom operator's recovery plan, including modernising its mobile equipment.
title: Huawei — Onatel recovery-plan credit, Burundi, 2017
description: « C’est finalement en novembre 2017 que le conseil des ministres a adopté un plan de redressement de 30 millions de dollars financé par un crédit octroyé par la société chinoise Huawei. » « Dans son plan de redressement, explique un bon connaisseur du dossier, l’Onatel pensait moderniser les équipements de l’Onamob, sa branche de la téléphonie mobile. » « Le contrat entre l’Onatel et Huawei, l’entreprise chinoise, prévoyait que les recettes de l’Onamob devraient être déposées sur un compte logé à la Bancobu pour le remboursement du crédit chinois. Mais les recettes demeurent insuffisantes. »
